items.title: Minecraft: Play with Friends!
items.subtitle: Explore, build, craft together
items.editorialDescription: If you can imagine it, you can create it—anything from monolithic towers to cavernous rollercoasters. That’s the idea that sparked a world-building phenomenon in Mojang’s amazing Minecraft. Since the game's release on the App Store, a steady stream of meaningful updates has kept this cube-filled universe fun, fresh and jam-packed with exciting features.

items.title: Heads Up!
items.subtitle: Play Charades with Friends!
items.editorialDescription: Created by Ellen DeGeneres, this riotous game-night challenge reinvents charades for the app generation. Pick a category, then hold your device up to your head, screen facing outward, and guess the words using your friends’ clues. Several categories are included, with many more available as In-App Purchases. Best of all, you can record and share videos of your friends’ increasingly frantic efforts to clue you in. Heads Up! puts a fun, fast-paced party starter in your pocket.

While the concept isn't exactly honorable, the surprising ways all these novel gameplay systems interact make this twist on traditional heroism a lot of fun — even though it shouldn’t be.

items.title: Toastie: grilled cheese game
items.subtitle: World's Most Expensive Toaster
items.tertiaryTitle: Designed for iPad
items.editorialDescription: You’ve got one goal in this slick cooking game: Make the perfect grilled-cheese sandwich! Follow the recipe—whether a simple three-cheeser or an adventurous Gruyère and red onion—and throw the whole thing into the toaster until golden brown. To get the timing right, count the number of times your iPhone vibrates—each pulse marks one second.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
items.subtitle: Action
items.tertiaryTitle: Designed for iPad
items.editorialDescription: A hugely ambitious action blockbuster, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is filled with sharp satire, fascinatingly flawed characters, and a huge variety of ways to play. Explore the cities and countryside of a vividly realized fictional version of the southwestern United States. You can tackle story-driven quests, gorge on fast food, outrun the police, or obey every traffic light—it’s up to you. This enormous game deftly displays Rockstar’s unique mastery of open-world design, and it never fails to entertain.

items.title: Terraria
items.subtitle: Dig! Fight! Explore! Build!
items.editorialDescription: An intriguing genre blend, Terraria mixes collection, construction, and combat in a retro-styled 2D adventure. Break apart the world, uncovering rare treasures and digging deep underground for resources to build elaborate houses. Then craft powerful weapons and armor before facing bizarre, fantastical creatures. It’s a huge, sophisticated experience that’s easy to spend hours with—a universe of densely layered surprises, where every session is exciting.

items.title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
items.subtitle: Epic fantasy Tower Defense
items.editorialDescription: Travel back in time to save Linirea in the latest version of this beloved tower-defense series. Familiar faces (and foes) abound, but we’re also fans of new challenge modes like Spell Rush, where you lose all your heroes but spells replenish more quickly. Not sure which heroes to equip? Cover your bases by having a stout defender like Rhodes alongside a heavy hitter like Bolin Farslayer.
